data.body:
Goal:
After every successful local mutation, push the changed files to each
known peer in peers.toml via rsync over ssh, best-effort. If a peer is
unreachable, log a warning to stderr and record the failure in the
peer state file (K-57); do NOT block or roll back the local mutation.
This is the "leader notifies other leaders" half of the design.

Verification:
1. After every Store mutation (init, recipient add/remove, set, create, update, delete, set with origin, recipient remove --rotate), Thimble triggers a `pushToPeers` step.
2. pushToPeers iterates peers.toml entries and runs rsync -av --delete `<store>/secrets/<app>/` <peer.target>/<app>/`. Each per-peer push is bounded by a context timeout (default 30s, configurable via THIMBLE_PEER_PUSH_TIMEOUT).
3. On peer push failure: emit one stderr line per failed peer ("peer push failed: <name> <reason>"); update `secrets/.peer-state.json` (K-57's file) with last-seen + last-error.
4. Receiving peer's flock + manifest version check (K-21) is what catches conflicts: if our push lands an older version than the peer's, the rsync still copies the bytes but the next mutation on the peer will see version skew and refuse.
5. New flag `--no-peer-push` on every mutating subcommand suppresses the broadcast (useful for batch ops).
6. New env var `THIMBLE_PEER_PUSH=off` globally disables the broadcast (single-leader mode).
7. Tests: mock rsync via a stub binary; assert push happens after a mutation, push respects timeout, failure surfaces correctly.

Constraints:
- Knot ref: K-56; depends on K-55.
- Files: internal/peer/push.go (new), internal/store/* hook integration, internal/cli/* flag wiring.
- Push happens AFTER the local commit succeeds, NOT as part of the flock'd critical section. A peer being slow must not slow the local mutation more than the push timeout.
- Failures DO NOT roll back local state. The local store is the source of truth for the leader; peers reconcile on next push or manual catch-up.
- This is synchronous-but-bounded: a `thimble set` blocks until peer pushes complete or time out. This is a deliberate trade-off — admin operations are not hot-path.
- Do NOT introduce a daemon. No background process, no goroutine that outlives the command.
data.title: On-mutate notify: best-effort rsync push to peers
